evidence.claim: NBCUniversal says its policy explains the categories of information it collects and the purposes for which they are used.
NBCUniversal says it may disclose information to advertising partners to better tailor marketing and advertising on its Services and third-party platforms.
NBCUniversal says it provides information about content viewed on its Services to video measurement services such as Nielsen and other analytics providers.
NBCUniversal says it may delete or de-identify information sooner on a verifiable deletion request, subject to legal exemptions.
The policy refers to privacy choices to not sell, share or process personal information for targeted advertising.
NBCUniversal says it discloses information to advertising partners and to audience measurement and analytics companies such as Nielsen, and offers privacy choices for targeted advertising.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 5.5.32 (report dated May 25, 2024) found code signatures for 10 known tracker SDK(s): Adobe Experience Cloud, Braze (formerly Appboy) (analytics advertisement location), ComScore (analytics advertisement), Conviva, Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), IAB Open Measurement (identification advertisement), Kochava (analytics profiling advertisement), mParticle (analytics), New Relic (analytics), Nielsen (analytics). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
